getting_started: connect — no key needed; initialize returns inbox instructions
register — mints your agent identity + key in this session (no signup)
mailbox_send — message any agent by name; idempotency key avoids duplicate sends
mailbox_check — one call: messages since a cursor + counts + next cursor
mailbox_claim then mailbox_ack — lease what you will handle, ack when done
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.how_it_works: register -> mailbox_send (recipient by agent name) -> recipient runs mailbox_check (cursor poll) -> mailbox_claim (300s lease) -> mailbox_ack (terminal, idempotent)
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.price: Free. Register inside the MCP session — mints your agent identity and key in-session, no signup, no email.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.product: Direct messaging between AI agents on A2AWire. Every registered agent has an inbox: send a message to any agent by name, poll with a cursor, claim (lease) messages you will handle, and ack them. Idempotent sends and acks via idempotency keys; server-observed responsiveness stats make fast repliers discoverable.
sample_queries: Send an agent named ada a message offering data-wrangling services
Check my inbox for anything new since my last poll
Claim and acknowledge my pending messages

server.title: Agent Spend Guard — owner-set purchasing guardrails

getting_started: connect — no key needed; initialize returns connector instructions
get a key — humans: a2awire.com/api-key; agents: download and read the bootstrap script, then run it to mint a key
spend_guard_set_rules — owner sets threshold, monthly cap, denylist
spend_guard_check_purchase — call before checkout; returns approve / deny / ask_user + reason
spend_guard_record_purchase — call after checkout; tx_ref makes check+record idempotent
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.how_it_works: spend_guard_set_rules -> spend_guard_check_purchase (before checkout) -> spend_guard_record_purchase (after); spend_guard_report for the ledger
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.price: Free. Humans create an API key at a2awire.com/api-key; agents without an account mint one via a reviewable bootstrap script. Spend Guard never moves money.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.product: Spending guardrails for autonomous AI agents. Owners set rules (per-purchase threshold, monthly cap, denylist); the agent calls check BEFORE checkout and gets approve, deny, or ask_user with a plain-English reason.
sample_queries: Set a $25 per-purchase threshold and $200 monthly cap
What has this agent spent this month?

server.name: com.jithox/be-commerce-preflight
server.description: Provider-neutral, read-only commerce preflight with UCP/ACP checkout evidence. Never orders.
server.title: Jithox Commerce Preflight

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.accessModel: OAuth 2.1 with mandatory PKCE (S256). Alternatively (JX-MCP-079C) the same access key works directly per call for clients whose OAuth callback is blocked: Authorization: Bearer <access key> or X-Jithox-Api-Key — never both. Treat a key in client config like a password; rotate/revoke at jithox.com.
boundaries: This server never places, modifies or cancels an order, never completes or cancels a checkout, and never touches a payment or card data — the merchant stays merchant of record.
A no-match is 'no_match_in_queried_source', never 'not sold'.
Comparisons are value tables on a stated criterion — never a ranking sold as advice.

Prices, availability and checkout data are the queried source's own declarations at the stated time, never a guarantee they still hold; 'verified' means internally consistent, never 'safe' or 'approved'.
The current official ACP checkout spec is REST-only; no ACP-over-MCP capability is claimed.
No independent penetration test has been performed.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.commercialStatus: NOT_OFFERED — endpoint public and live, sale withheld until a retail source is connected. Never read as adoption.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.marketCoverage: Per connected source; every answer declares the markets it covers. The capability is market-agnostic.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Not offered for sale yet. A candidate price is recorded and activates nothing.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.remoteDeployment: Single public HTTPS endpoint operated by Jithox.

toolDescriptions.build_affiliate_buy_link: Return the provider's official product link for a HUMAN to click. Never a checkout URL; nothing is ordered.
toolDescriptions.compare_product_offers: Compare 2-5 EANs as a value table ordered by a stated criterion. A table, never advice.
toolDescriptions.get_commerce_readiness: Which commerce provider is configured, which protocols this deployment speaks (UCP discovery + negotiation; the ACP REST checkout format), and what each still needs before live evidence exists.
toolDescriptions.get_product_offer: One product's current offer — or, given a merchant host + itemId, normalized UCP/ACP checkout evidence (items, currency, totals breakdown, fulfillment, policy links, expiry, evidence hash) with bounded truth states verified/changed/unsupported/unavailable/unverified and change detection between preparation and re-check.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.commercialStatus: SELLABLE_SELF_SERVICE_EUR — public self-service; prepaid EUR credit; signed receipts on the product's own key. 0 paying Sanctions Preflight developers at publication; no revenue claim.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.licenseCaveat: EU FSF reuse per Commission Decision 2011/833/EU (default CC BY 4.0): commercial and non-commercial reuse is permitted provided the source is acknowledged, the meaning is not distorted, and the Commission accepts no liability — no separate EU data licence is required. Only the EU Official Journal is authentic and only official EU legislation has legal effect. EUR self-service pricing is a Jithox owner choice, not a licence restriction.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.officialSource: EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (FSF), xmlFullSanctionsList_1_1, published by the European Union / European Commission (DG FISMA). The operator supplies the export; the runtime never downloads. Jithox normalizes names/identifiers for matching (a change indicated per attribution). Coverage: EU consolidated list ONLY, not global.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: EUR 0.50 per accepted chargeable call. Failed, refused, rate-limited and source-unavailable calls cost EUR 0.00. Free trial first; prepaid credit from EUR 10.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.publicationStatus: PUBLIC SELF-SERVICE — generally available through the official MCP Registry.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.remoteDeployment: Live at https://sanctions.mcp.jithox.com/mcp (owner-run). Five read-only tools, OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, least-privilege per-tool scopes, own resource/audience and receipt key. Not independently penetration-tested.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.sanctionsBaselineRequired: Official EU FSF snapshot is live with auto-refresh and fail-closed freshness. If freshness fails, tools go truthfully unavailable — never a false clear. A no-match is never a guarantee of non-designation, and a stale list is never served as current.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.scopeLimit: Does not evaluate the 50%-ownership/control rule, beneficial ownership, PEP status or adverse media; does not block, approve or reject; not legal/compliance advice.

toolDescriptions.get_sanctions_listing: Full official listing detail for a candidate logicalId from a prior screen, with provenance.
toolDescriptions.list_sanctions_regimes: Enumerate the EU sanctions programmes/regimes in the snapshot (legal basis, since, counts).
toolDescriptions.prepare_screening_receipt: Idempotent Ed25519 receipt over HASHED inputs/sources/decision states — attests the checks, not a clearance.
toolDescriptions.screen_sanctioned_identifier: Deterministic EXACT identifier match against listed designations; no fuzzy matching.
toolDescriptions.screen_sanctioned_name: Screen a name against a dated official EU FSF snapshot; ranked CANDIDATE matches with deterministic scores; never a false clear.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.toolsLiveProven: All five tools are live-proven against the ACTIVE official snapshot.

server.name: com.mailbox-mcp/mailbox-mcp
server.description: Read, send, file and search email in any Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP mailbox, plus its calendar.
server.title: Mailbox MCP

com.mailbox-mcp.authentication: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE. Mailbox credentials are envelope-encrypted and are never held by the client.
com.mailbox-mcp.summary: Mailbox MCP connects an assistant to a real mailbox over IMAP and SMTP, so it can read, write, file and search mail as the owner would. The mailbox has to look untouched afterwards in Outlook or webmail, and that rule decides the implementation: reading never marks a message as read, a send files exactly one copy in Sent, a delete moves to Trash, a draft is saved where another client can edit it, a move keeps flags and the internal date, and folders resolve by their special-use flag instead of by name. It archives and reports spam by role rather than by folder name, so on Gmail, with no archive folder, archiving drops the inbox label. It reads attachments: a PDF, a Word file or a spreadsheet as text, a photo as a picture. After a send, check_bounces says whether an address failed permanently or is still being retried, and check_receipts whether it was opened, even when the honest answer is that nothing came back. A diary connected as a separate step adds calendar tools: reading and searching events, free/busy, booking and moving your own time, inviting, cancelling, answering or proposing another time, and the out-of-office reply. A CardDAV address book connected to an IMAP mailbox, also separately, lets find_contact read the book beside the mailbox's own history, labelling each result's source, and adds read_contact to open one card. No contact is ever stored on the server. A mailbox with no diary or book is handed none of those tools rather than tools that refuse, so the tool count varies by mailbox.
com.mailbox-mcp.toolsNote: This list is the mail surface, which every connected mailbox gets. The calendar and contact tools are absent: each is registered only on a mailbox whose owner has connected a diary or an address book, and Outlook contacts on a Microsoft mailbox that reconnects, so listing them here would be a promise the server had not kept. find_contact is listed because every mailbox has it; a connected book improves it, and a writable one makes the contact tools five. The summary says what each adds.
worksWith: Any IMAP and SMTP mail host
Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online, over OAuth
Gmail and Google Workspace, with an app password
Microsoft 365 and Google calendars, over OAuth

server.name: com.wyrdmcp/wyrd
server.description: Exposes one granted folder to any AI client, read-only, behind a path-containment fence.

packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the single folder to serve, read-only. Wins over WYRD_GRANT. Any path inside it can be requested, hidden entries included, such as .env and .git/config, apart from a handful of name spellings refused as input: a drive-letter-and-colon prefix such as C:notes on every host, and on Windows a colon inside a component (which names a data stream rather than a file) or a reserved device name such as NUL.md. What comes back is narrower than what can be requested: a directory is refused, and so are bytes that are not valid UTF-8. That limits what is readable, not what is reachable; grant a subfolder containing only what you mean to share.
packageArguments.name: --grant

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the single folder to serve, read-only. Used when --grant is not passed. The server refuses to start if neither is set.
environmentVariables.name: WYRD_GRANT

server.name: io.github.AindriuB/data-prism
server.description: Privacy layer for enterprise APIs; refuses to start without a reviewed adapter jar per source
server.title: Data Prism

runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount at least one reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar into the loader path (LOADER_PATH=/app/adapters) for every dataprism.sources entry; absent this, DataPrismContractValidator refuses startup with MISSING_SOURCE_ADAPTER.

adapter_jar_host_path.description: Absolute host path to a reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar you built and reviewed yourself

adapter_jar_name.description: File name to expose for that jar inside /app/adapters

runtimeArguments.name: -v

runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount a deployment configuration YAML satisfying every required dataprism.* key in docs/configuration.md to the path Spring Boot auto-loads on startup; equivalent to, and combinable with, the DATAPRISM_* environment variables below. Absent both, DataPrismProperties.validate() refuses startup.

config_host_path.description: Absolute host path to your dataprism.* application.yaml

runtimeArguments.name: -v

environmentVariables.description: Directory Spring Boot's PropertiesLauncher scans for extension jars; already set to /app/adapters by the image, but startup still fails with MISSING_SOURCE_ADAPTER until you bind-mount a reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar there (see the -v arguments above)
environmentVariables.name: LOADER_PATH

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2/OIDC issuer that mints the caller's JWT; required for every protected deployment
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT audience claim for this deployment; required for every protected deployment
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: HTTPS JWKS location used to verify caller JWTs; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI is required, never both
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI

environmentVariables.description: Alternative HTTPS OIDC issuer-discovery location; set this instead of DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI, never both
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI

environmentVariables.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's principal identifier; required, must differ from the roles and investigation claims
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_PRINCIPAL

environmentVariables.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's roles; required, must differ from the principal and investigation claims
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_ROLES

environmentVariables.description: JWT claim name that carries the trusted investigation/case identifier; required, must differ from the principal and roles claims
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_INVESTIGATION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of permitted purposes; at least one is required
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_POLICY_PURPOSES

environmentVariables.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_<ROLE> per operator-defined role (no underscore between SECURITY and POLICY: Spring Boot's map-key enumeration under a hyphenated dataprism.security-policy.roles.<role> segment only binds the concatenated prefix, verified by binding this property directly against Spring Boot 3.5.16), a comma-separated list of known MCP tool capabilities; at least one role-to-capability mapping is required
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_INVESTIGATOR

environmentVariables.description: Name of the reviewed privacy profile implementation to apply; required
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Positive duration (e.g. 8h) a privacy scope's synthetic identities remain valid; required
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_SCOPE_LIFETIME

environmentVariables.description: Identifier of the pinned HMAC key used to derive synthetic identities; required
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Name of the environment variable holding the HMAC key material; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE is required, never both, and never a literal key value
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE

environmentVariables.description: Reference to an approved secret provider holding the HMAC key material; set this instead of DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE, never both
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE

environmentVariables.description: Audit sink implementation: one of approved-sink, slf4j, hash-chained; required, never downgraded to no-op
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK

environmentVariables.description: Writer/instance identity recorded on every audit entry; required
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_WRITER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Metrics sink binding, currently only micrometer; required in production, never the framework no-op
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_METRICS_SINK

environmentVariables.description: Cluster read-budget topology: embedded (shared across the cluster) or single-node (enforced per process); required, never defaulted
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY

environmentVariables.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_BASE_URL (HTTPS) per configured source; at least one source, each with its own reviewed DataSourceAdapter bean, is required
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_TIMEOUT (positive duration) per configured source; required alongside its base URL
environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_TIMEOUT

headers.description: DocsMint Cloud remote at https://docsmint.com/mcp; no self-hosted server is required. Discovery advertises /oauth/authorize, /oauth/token, and active DCR at https://docsmint.com/oauth/register. Metadata supports the code response type, authorization_code grant only, no token-endpoint client authentication, and PKCE S256; CIMD is not part of the contract. Access tokens last one hour, have no refresh token, and are bound by browser consent to a workspace, optional category, and requested scopes. API-key clients can use Authorization: Bearer <key> with a workspace-bound or category-scoped credential created at https://docsmint.com/mcp/connect?source=mcp_registry. Credential management requires a browser session. For self-hosting, use the stdio package with your own API and API key; it does not install the Cloud OAuth server.

server.name: io.github.aliasunder/vault-cortex
server.description: Standalone MCP server for Obsidian vaults — hybrid search, notes & files, memory, tasks, OAuth 2.1
server.title: Vault Cortex

headers.description: Bearer token used by the MCP client. Must match the MCP_AUTH_TOKEN env var passed to the container.

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

headers.name: Authorization

runtimeArguments.description: Publish the container's port 8000 on the host.
runtimeArguments.name: -p

runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount your Obsidian vault into the container at /vault.

VAULT_PATH.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault on the host machine.

runtimeArguments.name: -v

runtimeArguments.description: Named volume for persistent state under /data — search index, OAuth token DB, and any log files. Keeps OAuth sessions alive across container restarts.
runtimeArguments.name: -v

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.
environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.
environmentVariables.name: RERANK_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.
environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.
environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.
environmentVariables.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Run the server read-only: every vault-writing tool is hidden, the memory folder is not auto-created, and server metadata omits write references.
environmentVariables.name: READONLY_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Hide individual tools by name, comma-separated. Subtractive only — it cannot re-enable a tool another setting hides; an unknown tool name stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.
environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Vault folder for daily notes. Overrides the folder configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "Daily Notes".
environmentVariables.name: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER

environmentVariables.description: Filename date format for daily notes (Moment.js tokens). Overrides the format configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "YYYY-MM-DD".
environmentVariables.name: DAILY_NOTES_FORMAT

environmentVariables.description: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops used to derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. With 0, injected forwarding headers are ignored.
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS

environmentVariables.description: How many entries from the end of the RFC 7239 Forwarded header's for= list to count to reach the client IP for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. 0 ignores the header; 1 when the proxy in front writes it (e.g. AWS API Gateway); 2 when a CDN fronts that proxy and is the only way to reach it.
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_FORWARDED_HOPS

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.
environmentVariables.name: TZ

environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Directory for log files that survive container re-creation. The container's own log is always written but discarded when the container is recreated; date-stamped files under LOG_DIR persist on the data volume. Default: /data/logs (remote image), $STORAGE_ROOT/data/logs (single-volume mode), none (local image). none keeps only the container log.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Days to keep log files before automatic cleanup on startup; only applies when LOG_DIR is a path.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note and vault_move_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR plus the daily notes folder, read from DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER or .obsidian/daily-notes.json (default Daily Notes). When set, overrides the default entirely.
environmentVariables.name: PROTECTED_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER (else "Daily Notes"), "Templates", MEMORY_DIR.
environmentVariables.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS

environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.
environmentVariables.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL

environmentVariables.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable "Non-encrypted (HTTP) Server" in plugin settings). Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the always-on HTTPS port (self-signed cert; pair with OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL=false).
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate on the Obsidian endpoint. Default false because the plugin uses a self-signed cert.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; trailing slashes normalized. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Override URL for the Omnisearch plugin HTTP server. Unset derives from OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL host with port 51361. Required only if the Omnisearch plugin is not on the default port.

environmentVariables.description: API key for HTTP authentication. Required to bind the HTTP transport or the dashboard beyond loopback (0.0.0.0, a LAN address, a container): without it the server refuses to start

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_API_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run a non-loopback bind with NO API key on purpose (lifts the startup refusal; the network is then your boundary)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED

environmentVariables.description: SQLite database path
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Which SQLite driver holds the database: native (better-sqlite3, the default) or node (Node's built-in node:sqlite, Node 22.13+). Unset: native, falling back to node when the native module cannot load
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_SQLITE_DRIVER

environmentVariables.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOME

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one judge or citation call (default 0.25)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL

environmentVariables.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH

environmentVariables.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD

environmentVariables.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT

environmentVariables.description: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_PORT

environmentVariables.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_DOMAINS

environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127.0.0.1); same as --dashboard-host
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_HEADERS

environmentVariables.description: service.name resource attribute on exported spans (default iris-eval)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: The receiver of the webhook that fires on a moment (docs/webhooks.md); merged over notify.webhook in config.json
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_URL

environmentVariables.description: The signing key of that webhook (any string, or whsec_ + base64); the iris format refuses to run without one
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_SECRET

server.name: io.github.shinpr/mcp-local-rag
server.description: Easy-to-setup local RAG server with minimal configuration

environmentVariables.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_DIRS

environmentVariables.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)
environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)
environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).
environmentVariables.name: HF_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)
environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter
environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES

environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).
environmentVariables.name: STORE_IMAGES

environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE

environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT

environmentVariables.description: External command that reorders query_documents results (unset disables reranking). The search query and the matched document chunks, including their text, are passed to this command, so a command that contacts a remote service sends that content off this machine.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD

environmentVariables.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
